lines.t: I don't know what to do
I walk the paths of pride and vanity Lost in the noise of empty glory
Chasing shadows tangled in the lies Yet deep inside I long for holy skies
Come out of the world, come back to me Abide in my doctrine
Set your spirit free
I'll restore the broken
Make all things new
My kingdom is coming
And I'm calling you
Oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh
Wolves around me, voices filled with blame
But I'll not return evil for evil's name
Through tears and trials I'll walk this narrow road
Forgiven, holding fast to the hope bestowed
Come out of the world, come back to me
Abide in my doctrine, set your spirit free
I'll restore the broken, make all things new
My kingdom is coming, and I'm calling you
A day of thick clouds, then light will break
Sorrow will vanish, no more hearts to wake
Restored in love, in the fullness of grace
Praise forever with Him in His holy place
Come out of the world, come back to me
Abide in my doctrine, set your spirit free
I'll restore the broken, make all things new
My kingdom is coming, and I'm calling you
Thanks for watching!
